theme.designMd:
# Maqbool Essential
Use disciplined, slim product UI like Apple Files and Google Drive. Existing 224px sidebar, 70px header, bundled colorful geometric brand and Maqbool wordmark. Inter 13px body, 12px controls, 22px headings. Light #f7f8f7 canvas white surface #202923 text #e2e8e3 fine dividers. Dark #101113 canvas #191b1f surfaces #23252a inputs #32363d dividers #9cd7b9 action; never dark green. White space is intentional, not oversized. Compact rows, 8px corners, no nested card forests, no giant hero/status cards, no decorative illustrations. One main action and one quiet secondary per surface; less frequent actions in a More menu. Stable 860x760 dialogs: fixed header/tabs/footer, scrolling body. No technical implementation terms. Warnings only at the decision they affect. Do not add fake billing, nav, stats, activity sidebars, avatars or fabricated data policies. Purposeful line icons only, 140ms transitions and reduced-motion support.

# Maqbool Essential
Use disciplined, slim product UI like Apple Files and Google Drive. Existing 224px sidebar, 70px header, bundled colorful geometric brand and Maqbool wordmark. Inter 13px body, 12px controls, 22px headings. Light #f7f8f7 canvas white surface #202923 text #e2e8e3 fine dividers. Dark #101113 canvas #191b1f surfaces #23252a inputs #32363d dividers #9cd7b9 action; never dark green. White space is intentional, not oversized. Compact rows, 8px corners, no nested card forests, no giant hero/status cards, no decorative illustrations. One main action and one quiet secondary per surface; less frequent actions in a More menu. Stable 860x760 dialogs: fixed header/tabs/footer, scrolling body. No technical implementation terms. Warnings only at the decision they affect. Do not add fake billing, nav, stats, activity sidebars, avatars or fabricated data policies. Purposeful line icons only, 140ms transitions and reduced-motion support.

outputComponents.text:
I have designed both the Light and Dark desktop screens (1440 × 1000) for **Settings > Data & privacy**, adhering strictly to the Maqbool Essential design system and customer-facing workspace constraints.

### Design Details:
- **Navigation & Layout Continuity**: Replicated the slim 224px left navigation bar with the exact colorful geometric Maqbool mark and active Settings footer. Built the secondary Settings sub-navigation containing all required items (*Your account, Workspace, People, Teams, Roles & permissions, Data & privacy [active], Workspace updates, Integrations*).
- **Essential Storage Row**: Includes clean summary figures (`620 MiB of 2 GiB used` and `Includes earlier versions`), accompanied by a quiet, thin progress bar (at ~30% capacity).
- **Restrained Controls**:
  - Direct, unobtrusive action buttons: `Manage unfinished uploads` and `Export files`, with the exact bounded package notice (`Maximum package size: 2 GiB`).
  - Muted amber text indicator directly under export: *"Shared-drive files are references only. Their contents are not included."*
  - Dedicated **Workspace data export** section specifying structured JSON records without claiming full file backup.
  - Quiet, non-alarmist **Delete workspace** panel with standard 7-day retention schedule copy.
- **Strict Color Tokens**:
  - **Light Mode**: `#f7f8f7` canvas, crisp white surfaces, `#202923` primary text, `#176b50` accents, and quiet `#e5e7e5` 1px structural borders.
  - **Dark Mode**: `#101113` canvas, `#191b1f` surfaces, `#23252a` inputs/buttons, `#32363d` quiet borders, `#eeeeee` text, and `#9cd7b9` mint accenting (no solid dark green background fills).
- **Customer Language Only**: Avoided all technical backend jargon, hero cards, synthetic telemetry dashboards, and unrequested modal overlays.
